data.title: Are You Hungry?
data.statement:
You must find out how hungry you are by looking at the names of the previous foods you've eaten.

You will get [[n]] names of foods.
You will get your maximum food level [[max]]
For every [[food]], if the [[food]] name starts with A, it is worth one [[hungerPoints]]. If it starts with B, it is worth two [[hungerPoints]], and so on.

If [[hungerPoints]] ≤ 20% [[max]], then output "starving..."
If 20% [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]] ≤ 50% [[max]], then output "Yes, please!"
If 50% [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]] ≤ 85% [[max]], then output "I wouldn't mind eating something."
If 85% [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]] < [[max]], then output "Just a little bit."
If [[max]] ≤ [[hungerPoints]] ≤ 115% [[max]], then output "No thanks, I'm full."
If 115% [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]], then output "BURSTING!!!"
